claude.reason: The clause names the 5th-percentile terminal multiple, which the scales block identifies as primary_metric_best (tm_q05, break-even 1.0). That field is present for all nine symbols, so the clause is evaluable. It closes the family only if NO cell reaches above 1.0, and four reported cells do: ETHUSDT 3.6056, BTCUSDT 2.0510, SOLUSDT 1.6619 and BNBUSDT 1.1261. One such cell alone would defeat the clause; there are four. The clause is therefore not met and the verdict is CONTINUE. I am deliberately not reading the ranking metric: mwrr_q05_best is negative or near zero on most symbols (ETHUSDT 0.6789, BTCUSDT 0.3616, BNBUSDT 0.0815, and negative on five), but that is an annualised return on a 0.0 break-even scale and is not the metric the sentence names. For the record and not as grounds for closure: every measurable shape_diagnostic in this family reads SPIKE with a negative plateau_ratio (BTCUSDT -1.95 on a single neighbour, ETHUSDT -1.01 on a single neighbour, SOLUSDT -2.07, BNBUSDT -5.49); four symbols report the shape as unmeasurable because their peak is not positive on the ranking metric; independent_paths_best is between 1.02 and 1.40 on every symbol, so each of the 1120 trials rests on roughly one independent path; PBO is uncomputable on all three symbols where it was attempted ('fewer than two configurations share a horizon'); and the search test returns INDISTINGUISHABLE_FROM_SEARCH with p_value 1.0 on both ETHUSDT and SOLUSDT. None of that is written into the pre-registered kill condition, so none of it can close the family here.
